package.description: Ratspeak - a desktop/mobile client for Reticulum

en-US.author: Ratspeak and Ratspeak contributors
en-US.description: Ratspeak - a desktop/mobile client for Reticulum
en-US.longDescription: Ratspeak is a native desktop and mobile client for E2EE conversations over Reticulum, a new type of mesh networking. Ratspeak gives you messaging, file/image sharing, voice calls and voice messages (experimental), Channels, LoRa capability, WiFi, BLE, TCP, offline messaging, turn-based games, and more.
en-US.name: Ratspeak
en-US.releaseNotes:
v1.0.43

Added
- Close button choice on Windows: closing the window now asks whether to quit Ratspeak or keep it running in the system tray. Tick Don't ask again to keep your answer, and change it later in Settings › System › Close Button.

Fixed and improved
- USB RNodes on nRF52 boards, such as the Heltec T114 and T096, now connect on Windows instead of staying at Initializing.
- A newly added RNode now appears in the Radio list right away, while the radio is still starting.
- On iOS, lxm:// paper message links open Ratspeak.
